timing_source_note: Candidate compiled before local commit, with cc1dd3e42e in informational metadata. Only a private parameter rename and comment follow timing; reviewed final-source hashes and actual measured assembly hashes are retained.
host_policy: Default OS scheduling on M4 heterogeneous cores, no affinity, normal priority; no quiet-host claim.

measurement.interpretation: One baseline bracketed by two candidates, not two independent baseline pairs. Timing movements in unchanged lanes are retained.

validation: Every measured package passes strict OfficeIMO parsing and independent ExcelDataReader verification of every header and typed value. XLS also checks Index/DBCell structure. Complete generation, serialization, finalization and byte-array output are timed. The typed-cell diagnostic compares OfficeIMO revisions separately from the equivalent-work engine lanes.

earlier_run_interpretation.staged-trial: Existing staged ZIP route with growing MemoryStream and exact destination reservation; rejected after allocation rises from14.875 to16.515MiB without material throughput gain.
earlier_run_interpretation.pooled-trial: Initial pooled compressed snapshot; superseded only by direct span writes and final qualification.

profile.workload: Baseline XLSB generated selectors and typed-cell diagnostic; 2warmups,4measurements,128invocations. Sampled-thread-time and verbose GC; diagnostic data do not supply reported timings.
profile.interpretation: Source materialization, boxing, string generation and memory-stream growth remain visible. Native compression is retained at CompressionLevel.Fastest; no claim that sampled managed frames isolate its CPU time.

compatibility.selector_timing: Unchanged: source enumeration/disposal completes before row-major selectors; captured values are ready before WriteData returns.
compatibility.eligibility: Only privately retained flat snapshots targeting an exact empty MemoryStream, without a cancellable token or timing callback. Other routes retain the existing path.
compatibility.validation: All value/style/shared-string validation and ZIP finalization complete in owned storage before destination publication. All pooled chunks are cleared and returned.
compatibility.compression: CompressionLevel.Fastest unchanged. Baseline/candidate worksheet hashes, compressed worksheet bytes and total package sizes match.

smoke: PASS | Constructor-bound worksheet and table records retain values and native schemas
PASS | Excel DataReader, typed, and generic-only dictionary tables create, save, and reload

review.scope: Pooled compressed stream, source eligibility, prepublication validation, clearing/lifetime and test/benchmark proof

verification.heavy_run_policy: Every build/publish/test/benchmark/profile is serialized under heavy-run.lock; builds/native compilation use at most two workers. No GUI or Office application is used.
limits: Single normal M4 host; native DEFLATE CPU time is not isolated by managed sampling.
net472 cross-build only, without Windows runtime validation.
Timing varies in unchanged peer/control lanes; allocation and exact package metrics are the stronger evidence.
Selectors still box value-type results through the existing API; other destination/cancellation/timing routes retain native cell snapshots.
